items.reason: Reports reuse and mutation of a shared MetricsMiddleware instance, causing delegation errors and races. No golden issue describes this problem.
Reports missing nil-request guards in ContextualLoggerMiddleware. No golden issue covers these dereferences.
Reports missing nil-request guards in MetricsMiddleware, also covered by S9. These require fixes in different code from the contextual logger guards.
Reports metrics registry lookup failures preventing functional requests from reaching next. No golden issue describes this behavior.
Reports lost traceID correlation after logging switched to contextual attributes. S12 describes the same omission and fix.
Reports TestLogger.FromContext returning a fresh fake, making contextual log calls invisible to assertions on the original logger.
Reports request-size metric HELP text incorrectly describing inbound bytes as returned bytes. This differs from the golden FromContext documentation issue.
Reports the stale TestInstrumentationMiddleware name after the middleware and file were renamed to MetricsMiddleware.
Reports the same missing nil-request guards in MetricsMiddleware as S3, extending the report to additional methods.
Reports the same unguarded req.PluginContext dereferences in ContextualLoggerMiddleware as S2.
Reports the same fresh-instance behavior in TestLogger.FromContext that loses log observations on the injected fake.
Reports the same missing traceID contextual attribute and resulting loss of log correlation as S5.
Reports integer division truncating elapsed milliseconds before histogram observation. No golden issue covers measurement precision.
Reports incorrect multi-series matching in the test helper due to accumulated label counts and premature mismatch failure. No golden issue covers this helper logic.
Reports missing assertions that CheckHealth and CollectMetrics emit no request-size metrics. This is separate from the stale test name and label-matching helper problem.
